-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

read-document.name: read-document
read-document.description: Read a Word document as markdown (default) or HTML. Returns prose, not structure — use list-paragraphs when you need indices to edit.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

get-document-info.name: get-document-info
get-document-info.description: Get a Word document's OneDrive metadata, its Word document properties, and its paragraph and word counts.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

list-paragraphs.name: list-paragraphs
list-paragraphs.description: List a Word document's paragraphs with the stable indices that append-paragraphs, delete-paragraph, and the other edit tools target. Call this before editing to find the paragraph you mean. Text inside tables is not listed and cannot be targeted by index.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.

get-comments.name: get-comments
get-comments.description: Read the review comments in a Word document, with their authors and dates. Returns an empty list when the document has none.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

create-document.name: create-document
create-document.description: Create a new Word document from structured paragraphs. Fails if a file already exists at the path unless overwrite is set — an existing document is not recoverable from here except through OneDrive version history.

params.path: Destination path relative to the drive root, ending in .docx. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.paragraphs: The document body, in order. Each entry is { text, style?, bold?, italic? }; style may be Heading1, Heading2, or Heading3.
params.title: Optional document title property.
params.creator: Optional document author property.
params.overwrite: Replace an existing file at this path. Defaults to false, which fails instead.

replace-text.name: replace-text
replace-text.description: Replace text in a Word document, matching text as the reader sees it even when Word has split it across formatting runs. Text inside tables is not searched or replaced. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.search: Exact text to find. Not a regular expression.
params.replacement: Text to put in its place. May be empty to delete.
params.paragraphIndex: Optional paragraph index from list-paragraphs. Omit to replace throughout the document.

append-paragraphs.name: append-paragraphs
append-paragraphs.description: Add paragraphs to the end of a Word document, leaving everything already there untouched. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.
params.paragraphs: Paragraphs to append, in order. Each is { text, style? }.

delete-paragraph.name: delete-paragraph
delete-paragraph.description: Delete one paragraph from a Word document by its index from list-paragraphs. Indices shift after a delete, so re-list before deleting again. Cannot delete table content. Recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.
params.paragraphIndex: Zero-based paragraph index, as reported by list-paragraphs.

insert-table.name: insert-table
insert-table.description: Append a table to a Word document. Rows are plain strings; the first can be styled as a header. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.
params.rows: Table contents as an array of rows, each an array of cell strings. Every row must have the same number of cells.
params.headerRow: Render the first row in bold as a header. Defaults to false.

insert-page-break.name: insert-page-break
insert-page-break.description: Append a page break to a Word document, so subsequent content starts on a new page. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.

insert-image.name: insert-image
insert-image.description: Embed a PNG or JPEG image at the end of a Word document. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.
params.imageBase64: The image bytes, base64-encoded. PNG or JPEG.
params.fileName: Name to store the image under inside the document, e.g. "chart.png". No directory separators.
params.widthInches: Displayed width in inches. Defaults to 3.
params.heightInches: Displayed height in inches. Defaults to 2.

update-document-properties.name: update-document-properties
update-document-properties.description: Set a Word document's title, author, subject, or description — the properties Word shows in File → Info. Leaves the document body untouched. Overwrites the stored file; earlier states are recoverable only through OneDrive version history.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names.
params.title: Document title.
params.creator: Document author.
params.subject: Document subject.

convert-to-pdf.name: convert-to-pdf
convert-to-pdf.description: Convert a Word document to PDF and save it to OneDrive. Fails if a file already exists at the destination unless overwrite is set.

params.itemId: OneDrive item id of the .docx. Takes precedence over path, but requires destinationPath since there is no name to derive one from.
params.path: Path to the .docx relative to the drive root. Pass literal names, not pre-encoded ones.
params.destinationPath: Where to save the PDF. Defaults to the source path with its extension changed to .pdf.
params.overwrite: Replace an existing file at the destination. Defaults to false, which fails.

name: Word
description: Microsoft Word document automation — create documents, read their text and structure, and make surgical edits that leave the rest of the file untouched

changelog.notes: Initial release — create, read, and surgically edit Word documents in OneDrive
